title: Establish separate core repository size budgets and consolidate xtask shared library, workflow, and distillation modules
goal: Establish separate measured size budgets for first-party runtime Rust, vendor facades, tests, tooling, and vendored dependencies in tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs, classify vendor/.agents/docs in .gitattributes while preserving all audit trails and offline builds, document line accounting in docs/lean-core.md and README.md, extract duplicated xtask logic into xtask/src/lib.rs + xtask/src/common.rs to eliminate duplicate multi-binary compilation and test runs, and split xtask/src/bin/local-workflow.rs and xtask/src/distill_compose.rs into focused submodules.

reuse.source: Existing lean_core_ceilings harness and xtask shared modules
reuse.reason: Extend lean_core_ceilings with explicit runtime/test/tooling/vendor budgets and consolidate xtask's #[path]-duplicated modules into xtask/src/lib.rs without adding dependencies.
